description: Produce an SBR for crossflashing the Fujitsu D2607 from iMR (MegaRAID) mode to IT/IR (HBA) mode with all 8 SAS ports enabled.

requirements.preserve_board_identity: Keep Fujitsu subsystem vendor/product IDs unchanged
requirements.preserve_sas_address: Keep original SAS World Wide Name from the Fujitsu dump
requirements.preserve_hardware_calibration: Keep board-specific analog and timing parameters unchanged
requirements.all_integrity_checks_valid: All internal data integrity mechanisms must pass validation
